Class BunshinSearch

java.lang.Object
  bunshin.BunshinConnection
      bunshin.BunshinSearch

public class BunshinSearch
extends BunshinConnection

This class provides an extended methods of the DHT layer, making an owner keyword-search engine over Bunshin layer.

Author:
Ruben Mondejar
